python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/test/java/surveycrawler/SurveyCrawlerTest.java'; s=open(p).read()
for a,b in [
 ('crawler.process("h1");','crawler.process("h0");'),
 ('withBoulderAt(new Point(0, -1))','withBoulderAt(new Point(0, 1))'),
 ('withBoulderAt(new Point(2, 5))','withBoulderAt(new Point(3, 4))'),
 ('isAtFacing(new Point(3, -3), "Left")','isAtFacing(new Point(2, -3), "Right")'),
 ('withBoulderAt(new Point(4, 5))','withBoulderAt(new Point(4, 4))'),
]:
    assert s.count(a)==1, a
    s=s.replace(a,b)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
